questions.stem: I _______ my key yesterday, so I _______ wait outside for an hour.
options: B. have lost; have had to
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的辨析。句中有明确的时间状语"yesterday"（昨天），表示过去某个特定时间发生的动作，因此两个空都应用一般过去时。lose的过去式是lost，have to的过去式是had to。现在完成时强调过去动作对现在的影响，但此处只是陈述昨天发生的一系列过去动作，故不选B或D。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The girl _______ is singing on the stage comes from Class 3.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系代词的用法。先行词是"the girl"（指人），且关系代词在从句中作主语（is singing），因此应使用who。which用于指物；whom用于指人但在从句中作宾语；whose表示所属关系（谁的）。口诀：先行词指人作主语，关系代词用who。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book _______ by many students in our school last month.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时的被动语态。主语"the book"与动词"read"之间是被动关系（书被读），时间状语"last month"表明是过去时间，因此应用一般过去时的被动语态was/were + 过去分词。book是单数，故用was read。A选项是一般现在时被动语态；C是主动语态；D是现在分词，不能单独作谓语。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Whose notebook is this?
—It _______ be Mary's. Look, her name is on the cover.
questions.explanation: 本题考查情态动词表推测的用法。根据答句中的关键线索"her name is on the cover"（她的名字在封面上），这是确凿的证据，表示肯定推测，应用must（一定）。can't表示否定推测（不可能）；might表示不确定的推测（可能）；need不表推测。解题技巧：看证据是否确凿，确凿用must，确凿否定用can't，不确定用might/may。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The old bridge is not safe anymore because some parts are _______ and may fall down.
questions.explanation: 本题考查根据上下文猜测词义。根据前文"not safe anymore"（不再安全）和后文"may fall down"（可能倒塌），可推断出桥的部分结构已经"破损"。broken意为"破损的、断裂的"；built意为"建造的"；beautiful意为"美丽的"；busy意为"繁忙的"。只有broken符合语境逻辑。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We should _______ our best to protect the environment.
questions.explanation: 本题考查固定搭配。try one's best to do sth. 是固定短语，意为"尽某人最大努力做某事"。其他选项虽然也可以与best搭配，但意思不同：do one's best也表尽力，但通常不直接接to；make the best of意为"充分利用"；give one's best意为"尽力而为"，但用法不同。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It is _______ to drink too much coffee before going to bed.
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换及前缀用法。根据常识和句意，睡前喝太多咖啡是"不健康的"。un-是否定前缀，unhealthy意为"不健康的"；healthy意为"健康的"（与句意相反）；health是名词；healthily是副词。此处需要形容词作表语，且根据逻辑应选否定含义，故选B。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 本题考查固定搭配。do a survey是固定短语，意为"做调查"。虽然make/take也可以与survey搭配，但do最为常用且符合上下文语境。后文"We asked them..."也印证了此处是进行调查。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Many students in our school are interested in protecting the environment. Last month, our class started a special project called "Green Classroom". We wanted to find ways to reduce waste in our daily school life.

First, we (8)______ a survey among the students. We asked them about their habits of using paper and plastic bottles. The results showed that most students were willing to change their bad habits if they knew how to do it.

Then, we set up recycling boxes in each classroom. We also (9)______ posters on the walls to remind everyone to sort their rubbish. At first, some students didn't take it seriously. They thought it was (10)______ to separate waste every day.

However, after two weeks, we saw great changes. The amount of rubbish became (11)______ than before. Our head teacher was very surprised and praised us in the morning meeting. She said small actions could make a big (12)______ to our environment.

Now, more and more classes are joining us. We believe that if everyone does their part, our school will become greener and cleaner.

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。put up意为"张贴"，与posters（海报）搭配合理；paint意为"绘画"，虽然可以画海报，但此处更强调张贴到墙上；hand out意为"分发"，通常指传单；look for意为"寻找"。根据语境"on the walls"（在墙上），应选put up。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what happens when we sleep?
questions.explanation: 本题考查细节理解。根据文章第三段"During sleep, the brain processes and stores information from the day"（在睡眠期间，大脑处理并储存白天的信息），可知B选项正确。A选项（忘记一切）与文意相反；C选项（创造新细胞）文中未提及；D选项（肌肉变强）是第二段提到的memory works like a muscle的比喻，并非睡眠时肌肉真的变强。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Do you know why some people can remember things better than others? Scientists have done many studies on memory and found some interesting facts.

Memory works like a muscle. The more you use it, the stronger it becomes. When you learn something new, your brain creates connections between nerve cells (神经细胞). If you review the information regularly, these connections become stronger and the memory lasts longer.

However, many students complain that they forget things quickly after exams. This is because they often cram (临时抱佛脚) before tests instead of studying regularly. Dr. Li, a brain scientist from Beijing University, explains that sleeping also plays an important role in memory. During sleep, the brain processes and stores information from the day. That's why students who stay up late studying often perform worse than those who get enough sleep.

Another way to improve memory is to connect new information with something you already know. For example, if you meet someone named Rose, you might picture a red rose in your mind. This technique (技巧) makes it easier for your brain to find the information later.

So, if you want to have a good memory, remember these three keys: practice regularly, sleep well, and make creative connections.

questions.stem: What does the underlined word "cram" in Paragraph 3 probably mean?
options: A. Study hard for a short time before a test.
B. Sleep for a long time.
questions.explanation: 本题考查词义猜测。根据第三段语境"before tests instead of studying regularly"（考前代替日常学习），可知cram与"regularly studying"（定期学习）相对，意为"考前突击、临时抱佛脚"。A选项"在考试前短时间内努力学习"符合此意。B（睡很长时间）、C（定期复习）、D（快速遗忘）均不符合语境。

options: A. All students have the same memory ability.
B. Staying up late is good for exams.
C. Connecting new and old information helps memory.
D. Scientists know nothing about memory.

questions.stem: What is the best title for this passage?
options: B. The Importance of Nerve Cells

questions.explanation: 本题考查主旨大意/最佳标题。文章首段引出记忆的话题，随后各段分别介绍了提高记忆力的方法：定期复习、充足睡眠、联想记忆，最后总结这三个关键点。因此C选项"提高记忆力的方法"最能概括全文。A（如何睡好）、B（神经细胞的重要性）只是文中细节；D（为什么我们遗忘事物）并非文章重点。

questions.explanation: 本题考查段落衔接与逻辑关系。根据后文的"Second"、"Third"可知此处应为第一点建议，且后文提到"without breakfast"（不吃早餐），与A选项"以健康早餐开始一天"形成呼应。标志词First明确了顺序关系。
questions.label: 短文填空
questions.group_passage:
Having a good daily routine is important for middle school students. It helps us manage time better and stay healthy. Here are some tips for creating a good routine.

(17)______ Many students wake up late and rush to school without breakfast. This is bad for health. Try to get up 30 minutes earlier so you can have a proper meal.

Second, plan your study time wisely. (18)______ Don't try to do everything at once. Break big tasks into smaller ones and finish them step by step.

Third, make time for exercise. Physical activity helps reduce stress and improves concentration. (19)______ You don't need to play sports for hours. Even a 20-minute walk after dinner can help you relax.

(20)______ Go to bed at the same time every night. Avoid using phones before sleep as the blue light makes it hard to fall asleep.

With a good routine, you will feel more energetic and perform better at school.

questions.explanation: 本题考查例证关系。前句提到"明智地规划学习时间"，B选项"例如，在头脑清醒时学习困难的科目"是对前句的具体举例说明。For example是明显的例证标志词。
